description: Display of one internally illuminated projecting sign and one internally illuminated fascia sign; vinyl's to ground and first floor front glazing
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px; text-align: justify;">No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px; text-align: justify;">Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px; text-align: justify;">Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px; text-align: justify;">Where an advertisement is required under the Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px; text-align: justify;">The maximum luminance of the sign shall not exceed the values recommended in the Institution of Lighting Engineers' Technical Report No. 5 (Second Edition). The illumination shall be static and continuous and shall not be intermittent, flashing or otherwise animated.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 14.6667px; text-align: justify;">The advertisements hereby permitted shall only be illuminated between the hours of 07:00 and 22:00 on any day.</span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst">No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle">a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span>endanger persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle">b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span>obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or<o:p></o:p></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast">c)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span>hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.</p>
